incompatibleRuntime.title: This system is not supported by the bundled backend
incompatibleRuntime.description: 千机 opened, but the local Qianji Engine backend cannot run on this Linux version. Please upgrade to a supported Linux distribution and restart 千机.

incompleteInstallation.title: 千机 installation is incomplete
incompleteInstallation.description: This installation is missing required local resources, so Qianji Engine cannot start. Please download and reinstall the latest 千机. If the issue returns after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined Qianji Engine.
incompleteInstallation.runtimeComponentDescription: This installation is missing required bundled runtime components, so {{resource}} cannot start. Reinstall the latest 千机 package. If it still happens after reinstalling, check whether security or antivirus software quarantined 千机 components.

packageArchitectureMismatch.title: 千机 package architecture mismatch
packageArchitectureMismatch.description: This 千机 package is for {{packageArch}}, but this Mac is {{deviceArch}}. You may have downloaded the wrong package. Please download and install the {{expectedArch}} package.

dataMigration.title: Local data migration failed
dataMigration.description: 千机 opened, but Qianji Engine stopped while initializing local data. Reinstalling 千机 may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database migration can be inspected.

databaseNewerThanApp.title: A newer version of 千机 is required
databaseNewerThanApp.description: Your local data was created by a newer version of 千机, and this version can't open it. Update 千机 to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.
databaseNewerThanApp.descriptionWithVersion: Your local data was created by a version of 千机 newer than the one installed now (v{{currentVersion}}), so this version can't open it. Update 千机 to the latest version to continue — your data is intact, and no reinstall or data reset is needed.

localDataRepair.title: Local data repair failed
localDataRepair.description: 千机 opened, but Qianji Engine stopped while preparing local startup data such as assistant or agent records. Reinstalling 千机 may not fix this. Send a diagnostics report or contact support so the local database can be inspected.

startupDirectory.title: Startup directory is unavailable
startupDirectory.description: 千机 opened, but Qianji Engine could not start because the configured work or log directory is missing, unavailable, or blocked by permissions. Check that the configured directories exist and are writable, then restart 千机.

recoverableDatabaseCorruption.title: Local data is corrupted
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.description: 千机 detected that the local database is corrupted and cannot continue startup. After confirmation, 千机 will back up the old database and create a new local database to continue startup. Past conversations will no longer be shown, and the old database will be kept as a backup file.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.confirmRebuild: Back up old DB and rebuild new DB
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.diagnosticsHint: Sending diagnostics will not modify the local database.
recoverableDatabaseCorruption.rebuildFailed: Failed to back up old DB and rebuild new DB

confirmDialog.title: Rebuild the database?
confirmDialog.content: This will back up the currently corrupted database and create a brand-new empty one. Past conversations will no longer be shown (the old database is kept as a backup file). Continue?

transientConcurrentStartup.title: 千机 is starting up
transientConcurrentStartup.description: Another 千机 startup was still using the local data when this window opened. This is temporary and your data is safe — no reinstall is needed. Please wait a moment and try again, or restart 千机.
transientConcurrentStartup.diagnosticsHint: If this keeps happening, you can send a diagnostics report.

pendingSlow.title: Starting up
pendingSlow.description: Qianji Engine is starting up, please wait. If it doesn't respond after a while, you can quit and reopen the app.

exited.title: Startup didn't complete
exited.description: Qianji Engine couldn't finish starting and has exited. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
exited.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

portReportTimeout.title: Startup timed out
portReportTimeout.description: Qianji Engine didn't finish starting within the expected time. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
portReportTimeout.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

startupFailed.title: Startup failed
startupFailed.description: Qianji Engine failed to start. Please restart the app; if this keeps happening, please send diagnostics.
startupFailed.diagnosticsReportFailed: Failed to send diagnostics, please retry

product.name: 千机
product.description: An AI workspace for Guotai Haitong, supporting research, documents, data analysis, and everyday work.
product.internalOnly: For internal use at Guotai Haitong
product.support: For account or access issues, contact your internal system administrator.
product.usageNotice: Follow company data policies. Verify AI-generated content before use.
product.upstreamNotice: Contains open-source software. See the bundled licenses and source notices.
product.updatesNotice: Product releases are managed by your internal administrator.
product.connectionNotice: Model connections are configured by administrators or users. Verify service endpoints and permitted data use before proceeding.
product.capabilityResearchDesc: Organize source material and extract key insights
product.capabilityDocumentsDesc: Draft, review, and organize business documents
product.capabilityDataDesc: Analyze data and communicate clear findings
product.loginIntro:
Connect knowledge with action.
Bring a fresh perspective to everyday work.
product.loginDescription: Use your platform account to get started.
product.workspaceTitle: What shall we work on today?
product.workspaceSubtitle: Start with a document, a question, or a task.
product.scenariosHint: Choose a scenario, then add your context
product.researchDescription: Key insights · Source references · Open questions
product.researchPrompt: Review the research material I provide. Summarize the key insights, data, and risks, cite the supplied sources, and clearly mark missing or unverified information. Do not invent data.
product.documentDescription: Clear structure · Accurate language · Ready to review
product.documentPrompt: Help me draft a business document. First confirm the audience, purpose, key points, and format. Then prepare a structured draft, marking facts, figures, and commitments that require confirmation.
product.dataDescription: Define metrics · Compare trends · Identify signals
product.dataPrompt: Analyze the spreadsheet I provide. Confirm the fields, date range, and metric definitions first. Summarize trends and anomalies, distinguish facts from hypotheses, and list items needing further verification.
product.meetingDescription: Capture decisions · Clarify actions · Track follow-up
product.meetingPrompt: Organize my meeting notes into topics, discussion points, confirmed decisions, and action items. Only assign owners and deadlines explicitly recorded in the source; mark other details as unconfirmed.
product.presentationPrompt: Create a business presentation from the materials I provide. Highlight conclusions, supporting data, and next steps. Mark missing information as pending confirmation.
product.planningPrompt: Turn the business task I provide into an execution plan with steps, dependencies, milestones, and open questions. Include owners and deadlines only when explicitly stated in the source material.
